From: Samira Patel <samira@heliohealth.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity demo request - HelioHealth

Hi Ben,

We just completed the self-serve onboarding and saw the Dedicated option in the console — thanks for making that available. We have a proof-of-concept that needs predictable throughput for document generation and retrieval (roughly 1000 concurrent users, 8 reqs/sec peak, ~120 tokens per response on average).

Can we schedule a short walkthrough focused specifically on Dedicated capacity sizing, latency expectations, and what a canary rollout looks like? We'd prefer a live look at how batching and KV cache affect latency for our workload.

Available windows next week (PDT): Tue 5/18 10:00-12:00, Wed 5/19 14:00-16:00. Happy to share a short spec — attaching the initial throughput profile.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Patel
Director of ML Infrastructure
HelioHealth

Attachments: dedicated-throughput-specs.pdf (stub)

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo request - HelioHealth

Thanks Samira — really appreciate the context and the spec. Welcome!

Quick intake questions so we tailor the session:
- Is the 8 reqs/sec your sustained average or peak?
- Target p95 latency requirement (ms) for user-facing calls?
- Any regulatory constraints (data residency / VPC)?

We can do a 30–45 minute walkthrough that covers capacity sizing, canary rollouts, and cache/batching tradeoffs. My suggested slots (PDT):
- Tue 5/18 10:30–11:00
- Tue 5/18 11:30–12:00
- Wed 5/19 14:30–15:15

If those don't work I'll loop in our infra PM (Priyom) who can run a quick perf demo with a sample workload. I've attached a calendar invite stub (calendar-invite-v1.ics) — please confirm the slot that works and we'll send a Teams link.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

From: Samira Patel <samira@heliohealth.ai>

Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 12:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo request - HelioHealth

Hi Ben — thanks. Couple quick answers:
- 8 reqs/sec is closer to peak sustained during batch processing windows; baseline is ~3 rps.
- We aim for p95 < 450ms for user-facing endpoints; p95 < 200ms for internal async pipelines if possible.
- Data must remain in US regions (we're multi-tenant but need tenant isolation); VPC preferred.

Tue 5/18 11:30–12:00 works for our team. Attaching the spec and a short sequence diagram. I'll be joined by our infra lead (Tom Brooks) — he's on the same domain (tom.brooks@heliohealth.ai).

Thanks,
Samira

On attachments: dedicated-throughput-specs.pdf (already attached)

Ben, FYI I can take the 11:30 slot today (PDT). For the demo I'll prepare two short runs:
1) 3 rps baseline with aggressive KV caching to show median p50/p95 improvement
2) Synthetic 8 rps sustained peak with batching disabled/enabled to highlight tail behavior

Can you confirm:
- Preferred model family (open LLM vs. fine-tuned private model)?
- Max sequence length (tokens input + output) for your typical calls?

I'll also bring a quick diagram of how Dedicated pools map to tenant isolation and failover policies so Tom has the details he needs for procurement.

See you at 11:30. I'll send the meeting link right now.

— Priyom
